verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say code review supports both the Pull Request and AGit workflows, with reviewers browsing code online and leaving review comments ([gitea-docs-3], [gitea-docs-12]). The docs also list reviewing and merging code submissions and branch handling as core features ([gitea-docs-1]), which covers proposing, discussing and merging changes. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of merge options, required approvals or branch protection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR workflow specifically.
